A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MARS research and contain readable main text and Appendices A–F. Text, equations, tables and embedded plots support a reliable comparison despite pagination changes.

before.justification: V3 reports original GPT-2 training and downstream evaluation results, plus computer-vision experiments and sensitivity studies in Appendix E.

after.justification: V4 retains these original empirical results, including language-model training, downstream evaluations and CIFAR experiments.

M1.justification: MARS Algorithms 1–4, gradient correction, clipping, preconditioning and exact/approximate implementations are unchanged. The revised Lion equivalence concerns mathematical justification rather than the proposed optimization procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain OpenWebText and FineWeb-Edu 100B language-model experiments, the same downstream benchmarks, and ResNet-18 classification on CIFAR-10/100. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The corresponding experiments retain the same comparators: AdamW, Lion and Muon for OpenWebText; AdamW, Muon and OpenAI-Comm. for FineWeb-Edu; and AdamW, Lion, Shampoo and Muon for vision. The Lion derivation correction does not document a changed experimental implementation.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendices E–F retain the same reported splits, model sizes, metrics, training budgets, hyperparameters and evaluation procedures. The revised Figure 1 curves are not accompanied by a stated protocol change.

E4.justification: Appendix E retains the exact-versus-approximate comparisons, gamma sensitivity, constant/WSD learning-rate studies and batch-size sensitivity analysis. Their questions, findings and plots are unchanged despite relocation.

E5.justification: Both versions report base seed 5000 in Table 11 and use the same point-estimate reporting. Neither introduces repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: Figure 1 revises Muon's training and validation curves, including the wall-clock view, under the same stated GPT-2 large/OpenWebText setup. Its plotted minimum validation loss decreases from approximately 2.61 to 2.58, although Section 4.2 still reports 2.606. The other methods' curves, appendix plots and Tables 1–9 retain their results.

T1.justification: Section 3.2.2 corrects the Lion recurrence and its MARS parameter mapping: after relabelling the beta parameters, gamma becomes (beta2−beta1)/beta2 instead of 1−beta2. Lemma 3.4 is revised for the appropriate momentum timing, and Appendix D.1 adds its proof. The convergence assumptions, Theorems B.5–B.6 and their substantive proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same unified-framework contribution, three MARS instantiations, optimizer connections and claims of improved training efficiency and downstream performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations of exact versus approximate MARS, dataset quality, scheduler flexibility and stronger benefits at smaller batch sizes are retained. V4 adds no substantive limitation or interpretation of the revised Muon curves.

D1.justification: The code-access information, hardware descriptions, preprocessing, hyperparameter searches and settings in Tables 10–12 are unchanged. Moving these disclosures does not change reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain the same, including Appendix A. Lion remains characterized as a special case of approximate MARS-Lion; v4 corrects the mathematical support for that retained relationship.

P1.justification: V4 removes the duplicated Lion-equivalence passage, locally rewrites its explanation, adds a proof subsection and updates equation references. The broader language and section organization remain stable.

P2.justification: Figure 1's Muon curves are redrawn, while its axes, legend and caption remain effectively unchanged. Existing appendix figures and tables are redistributed across pages, including Figure 19 and Tables 10–12 on page 35, without a broader visual redesign.

improvement.justification: The corrected Lion/MARS equivalence and its new proof resolve a mathematical error in a claimed optimizer connection, while removing duplicated exposition improves clarity. These support a limited overall gain. The revised Muon curve introduces a reporting inconsistency with Section 4.2's unchanged best loss of 2.606, but does not overturn the retained MARS ranking.
